name: trygon_predator_declined_destroys_nothing
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may destroy target artifact or enchantment that player controls.' The Predator deals 2 combat damage to seat 1. Seat 1's artifact is the one legal target (seat 0's own artifact is not 'that player's'); seat 0 declines the 'may': nothing is destroyed.
